title: The dynamic generalized covariance measure for conditional independence testing with nonstationary time series
abstract: arXiv:2504.21647v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Identifying relationships among stochastic processes is a core objective in many fields, such as economics. While the standard toolkit for multivariate time series analysis has many advantages, it can be difficult to capture nonlinear dynamics using linear vector autoregressive models. This difficulty has motivated the development of methods for causal discovery and variable selection for nonlinear time series, which routinely employ tests for conditional independence. In this paper, we introduce the first framework for conditional independence testing that works with a single realization of a nonstationary nonlinear process. The proposed test is designed to have power against alternatives in which the expected conditional covariance is non-zero for at least some times. We also discuss an approach for gaining power against a broader range of alternatives. The key technical ingredients of our framework are time-varying nonlinear

translated_title: 用于非平稳时间序列条件独立性检验的动态广义协方差度量
translated_abstract: 识别随机过程之间的关系是经济学等许多领域的核心目标。虽然标准的多变量时间序列分析工具具有诸多优势，但使用线性向量自回归模型往往难以捕捉非线性动态。这一困难推动了针对非线性时间序列的因果发现与变量选择方法的发展，这些方法通常采用条件独立性检验。在本文中，我们提出了首个适用于非平稳非线性过程单次观测序列的条件独立性检验框架。所提出的检验方法旨在针对期望条件协方差在某些时刻非零的备择假设具有检验功效。我们还讨论了一种能够对更广泛的备择假设获得检验功效的方法。我们框架的关键技术要素是时变非线性……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了首个基于动态广义协方差度量的条件独立性检验框架，可对非平稳非线性时间序列的单次观测数据进行检验，能够检测出期望条件协方差在某些时刻非零的依赖关系。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the first conditional independence testing framework for a single realization of nonstationary nonlinear time series, based on a dynamic generalized covariance measure with power against alternatives where the expected conditional covariance is non-zero at some times.
